#  11398 - Information Management and Modelling using GIS Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11398 - module is no longer offered from WS 2015/16**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Information Management and Modelling using GIS**  |  
|  Information Management und Modellierung mit GIS   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. PD Dr.-Ing. habil. Molkenthin, Frank 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  On special announcement   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Understanding GIS technology and information management, knowledge of information modelling and analysis with spatial references, skills working with GIS as Desktop application and using Web services, refresh of database and programming technology and workflow modelling, competences in effective GIS application in environmental and water related engineering projects  |  
| Contents:  | Introduction to GIS software, data and services, coordinate reference systems, vector data management and analysis, raster data management and analysis, GIS and related data base standards, information modelling within GIS, WEB-GIS and mobile GIS techniques and solutions, metadata and INSPIRE initiative, environmental information systems and Web portals, interfacing to other software systems, GIS as modelling framework, application examples and case studies from environmental and water related engineering problems  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Basic knowledge and experiences in information and computer technology (ICT) applied in engineering and natural sciences, Module Statistics (ERM)  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | 
  * Module 11110 Mathematics for Engineering I
  * Module 11111 Mathematics for Engineering II

 |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | lecture notes in German and English language incl. literature and reference list will be provided to course participants  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  |  3 assignments during the semester 1 written exam Overall grade: each assignment 10%, written exam 70%  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  |  
| Module Components:  | 411010 Lecture Information Management and Modelling using GIS 411020 Exercise Information Management and Modelling using GIS 841234 Examination Information Management and Modelling using GIS  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
